title: Incident with Actions, Pull Requests and Issues
summary: GitHub experienced a service disruption affecting Actions, Pull Requests, and Issues features, which was reported on GitHub Status and discussed on Hacker News with significant community engagement (120 points, 107 comments).
problem_solved: This incident report documents a GitHub platform outage affecting core development workflow features rather than solving a problem.
why_valuable: Provides transparency on platform reliability and helps developers understand the scope and nature of major SaaS service disruptions affecting millions of developers worldwide.
